rows.grounds: adverbial compound tad+adhaḥ indicating position below that
masculine noun; syntactic role depends on construction

items.question: What is to be constructed below that together with the sage and quality portions?
premises: The verse names a location below that.
items.inference: Foot-pavements are to be made below that with the sage and quality portions.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic role of muni is unclear.
The dual form pādakuṭṭimau may be nominative or accusative.
items.plain_english: Below that, with the sage and the portions of qualities, the two foot-pavements are to be made.
